summary_en: This study tests ficerafusp alfa given together with pembrolizumab before surgery in people with resectable, high-risk, locoregionally advanced, PD-L1-positive squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck. Both drugs are given by intravenous infusion, with pembrolizumab on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle and ficerafusp alfa on Days 1, 8, and 15 of cycle 1 and on Day 1 of cycle 2, followed by standard surgery. The record states that the study measures safety and efficacy, but a specific primary outcome is not stated; this is a Phase 2 trial.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa ficerafusp alfa combinado con pembrolizumab antes de la cirugía en personas con carcinoma de células escamosas de cabeza y cuello resecable, de alto riesgo, localmente avanzado y positivo para PD-L1. Ambos medicamentos se administran por infusión intravenosa: el pembrolizumab el Día 1 de cada ciclo de 21 días, y el ficerafusp alfa los Días 1, 8 y 15 del ciclo 1 y el Día 1 del ciclo 2, seguido de cirugía estándar. El registro indica que el estudio mide la seguridad y la eficacia, pero no se indica una medida de resultado principal específica; es un estudio de Fase 2.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with newly diagnosed, untreated, locoregionally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
Tumor arises from the oral cavity, oropharynx (HPV-negative), larynx, or hypopharynx.
Disease is resectable in the opinion of the treating surgical oncologist.
Tumor is PD-L1 positive, with a CPS score of 1 or greater.
ECOG performance status 0 or 1, and willing to provide blood and tissue samples.
not_for: Recurrent or metastatic head and neck cancer, or very early stage (stage I or II) disease.
Prior anti-EGFR antibody or anti-PD-1 immunotherapy.
Active autoimmune disease needing systemic treatment in the past 2 years.
Active hepatitis B or C, HIV, or prior organ transplant, as listed in the exclusion criteria.
cancer_types: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck
